name: Sagisawa Misaki
source: A girl of noble blood, who was unable to leave her house out of fear of the outside world in general, and of the people in particular. Fortunately, with the help of Jun'ichi and cat Yoriko, she managed to make this difficult step and discover a big new world. Misaki is a very kind and polite girl, and her boyfriend would be happy to ask her for a date, but her father proved to be a man of strict rules...
